name: fscanf
expr: fname = tempname; fid = fopen(fname, 'w'); fprintf(fid, '1 2 3 4 5'); fclose(fid); fid = fopen(fname, 'r'); v = fscanf(fid, '%d'); fclose(fid); delete(fname); r1 = double(sum(v));
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip in single snippet via tempname). fscanf reads formatted -- sum of [1..5] = 15.
